name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Bauer, Europa, and Plankton belong to different colonists.
Plankton goes with at least one of Bauer, Rios, or Ceres.
Bauer, Titan, and Basalt belong to different colonists.
